uncertainReason: Released 20 October 2026 (The Fractured Archive, 4th encounter, alternative to the Dagon'hai trio). Infobox 'Max hit: ? (edit)'; the strategy guide's only damage numbers are the pillar blast (~45 full, ~7 behind a pillar). The three auto-attack max hits below are a PROXY = the regular Tormented Demon infobox 'Max hit 31 (auto)' (Xarth is 'a unique tormented demon boss'; stats Attack 250 / Strength 225 / Magic 350 / Ranged 220 vs the regular demon's 255 across the board), not wiki numbers for Xarth. Phase 1 vs phase 2 length is not HP-based ('Phase 2 begins when all pillars are gone'), so the 0.5/0.5 split is an assumption. Hitpoints scale: 2,600 at team size 1, 4,860 (4), 5,950 (5), 7,050 (6), 8,140 (7), 9,230 (8); the raid page says solo is scaled as two players.

attacks.name: magic auto (phase 1, exclusively magic)
attacks.note: PROXY max hit (regular Tormented Demon 31; Xarth infobox '?'). Infobox: 'Attack speed 4 ticks (2.4 seconds)', 'Attack styles: Mage, Ranged, Melee'. Strategies: 'Xarth attacks exclusively with magic during this phase.' and 'Unlike other Tormented Demons, Xarth does not have a shield to block incoming damage, however he does attack much faster.' He 'prioritizes attacking the closest player.' One style -> the camped prayer (Protect from Magic) covers it; the guide 'contains no sentence recommending Protect from Magic in phase 1' and says nothing about full/partial blocking; no piercing documented -> prayerFactor 0. 'At certain scales, he will never attack one player' ('seems to be randomly decided each raid'). Burn rider: see the burn row. Share 0.5 assumes half the fight is phase 1.

attacks.name: burn (stacking, from phase-1 magic hits and the blasts)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'His magic attacks will inflict a burn which can stack over time.' Burn page (status effect): 'Burning targets take 1 HP every 4 ticks (2.4 seconds)'; 'Up to 5 burn instances can be active at once'; 'each damage tick equals the current stack count' -> up to 5 per 4 ticks at full stacks (maxHit 5, speedTicks 4); 'Protect from Missiles does not reduce burn damage' (burn counts as ranged damage for immunities). BUT the Burn page files Xarth under 'Similar mechanics', not true burns: 'Phase 1 magic attacks inflict a burn that stacks with each attack. Phase 1 and 2 AoE blasts inflict a burn starting at 3 damage. Players lined up behind the first struck player take a 1-damage burn.' Whether a magic hit blocked by Protect from Magic still applies the burn is not stated. Chip damage good play may still eat, but with its gating unknown it is listed with share 0 (a DoT, not an attack cycle) - count it as up to 5 per 4 ticks if you decide the burn lands through prayer.

attacks.name: bind + two searing projectiles + explosive blast (phase 1, fixed timer)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'On a fixed timer, he will bind all players and launch two searing projectiles while charging up an explosive blast.' (timer length not stated -> speedTicks 0). 'Once the projectile are launched, immediately hide behind the pillar to avoid damage from the blast.' Everyone should 'stand behind one pillar and path the same direction to it' or several pillars get destroyed. Numbers: 'In a pinch, a player can act as a pillar. They will take the full ~45 damage and those behind will take ~7.' 'DDing will cause all players to take the full damage.' Blast burn: 'inflict a burn starting at 3 damage' (Burn page). Style/prayer not stated -> typeless assumed. Hidden behind a pillar = 0 -> avoidable, never counted; the searing projectiles have no stated damage. Each blast consumes pillars; 'Phase 2 begins when all pillars are gone.'

attacks.name: ranged auto (phase 2, static in the centre)
attacks.note: PROXY max hit 31 (infobox '?'). Strategies: 'He will no longer use magic attacks, instead swapping to ranged and melee, though he remains static in the centre of the arena.' 'He always attacks the player closest to him.' 'His ranged attack's damage is calculated as the projectile hits you.' -> pray Protect from Missiles as it lands (flicked; projectile is the telegraph); 'The page gives no prayer advice for phase 2'. Mixed with melee, so a camped single prayer eats the other style; leak 0.1 estimate. Ranged:melee ratio not stated -> 0.25/0.25 of the whole fight. Dev intent (newspost): 'for players to be meleeing his final phase'.

attacks.name: melee auto (phase 2, adjacent players only)
attacks.note: PROXY max hit 31 (infobox '?'). Same phase-2 rules: static in the centre, 'always attacks the player closest to him'. A meleeing player (the intended final phase) eats mixed melee/ranged, so flicked with leak 0.1 estimate; a player who stays out of melee reach would convert this share into ranged. Full block not stated; no piercing documented -> prayerFactor 0. Share estimate.

attacks.name: flames (ground hazards, phase 2)
attacks.note: No number (0 = unknown). Strategies: 'He will launch several flames into the arena, serving as hazards that will deal damage and inflict burns if stepped on.' They 'periodically spread to adjacent tiles.' Positional -> avoidable, never counted.

attacks.name: corpse-heal AoE blast (phase 2, when corpses heal him 200)
attacks.note: No number ('heavy damage'; 0 = unknown). Strategies: 'Xarth will reanimate corpses from the edges of the arena that will approach him'; 'If allowed to reach him, they will heal him for their remaining health.' (Corpse (Xarth): 62 HP, level 89.) 'If the corpses heal Xarth for 200 health, he will respond with a large AoE blast across the entire arena, dealing heavy damage and inflicting a burn on them.' Mitigation: 'The AoE blast can have reduced damage by positioning the team behind the tank'; 'The damage from the blast can be venged.' Prevention: freeze the corpses or douse them with water spells ('Water spells and ice spells are 1-tick on corpses'; frozen/doused corpses take 'guaranteed max hits from melee and light ranged attacks'); 'Fire spells spawn more corpses'. Corpse spawn rate increases 'as Xarth's health lowers'. Prevented by standard play -> avoidable, never counted.

phases: Phase 1 (pillars standing): magic only, faster than a normal Tormented Demon (4-tick sheet speed), stacking burn, closest-player targeting, fixed-timer bind + two searing projectiles + ~45 blast that destroys pillars unless the team hides behind one. Phase 2 ('when all pillars are gone'): no magic; ranged + melee from a static position in the centre, flames spread on the floor, corpses walk in to heal him (200 healed -> arena-wide blast + burn), spawn rate rising as his HP falls. No HP-percentage thresholds are documented.
sanityOrOther: No shield and no documented prayer-swap, unlike a regular Tormented Demon ('Unlike other Tormented Demons, Xarth does not have a shield'). Has the demon attribute ('susceptible to demonbane'), 85% water elemental weakness, immune to poison and cannons, not immune to thralls or burn. Hotfix 21 October 2026: 60% cap on Defence reduction (170 -> minimum 102). Newspost: 'using the Twisted Bow on Xarth is completely fine'. Music: Forged Through Fire.
